saddle-road-hawaii.title: Saddle Road Hawaii
saddle-road-hawaii.slogan: Hilo to Waimea · one way, about 173 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Hilo
waypoints.advice: Hilo is where the day begins. Next is Mauna Kea Access Road junction.

waypoints.name: Mauna Kea Access Road junction
waypoints.advice: Mauna Kea Access Road junction comes up 58 km in. Next is Saddle summit.

waypoints.name: Saddle summit
waypoints.advice: 115 km in you reach Saddle summit. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Waimea, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Waimea
waypoints.advice: Waimea closes the day.

sections.advice: Hilo → Mauna Kea Access Road junction is 49 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Mauna Kea Access Road junction → Saddle summit climbs about 2020 m in 14 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Saddle summit → Waimea drops about 2020 m over 39 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

saddle-road-hawaii.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Saddle Road Hawaii. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Saddle Road Hawaii
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2020 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Saddle summit → Waimea
scenicChapters.narrative: 2020 m come off over 67 km at around 5.1%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

saddle-road-hawaii.story: 173 km from Hilo to Waimea, about 2 h 21 of riding. On the way it passes Mauna Kea Access Road junction and Saddle summit. The highest point is about 2,450 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.title: Luxembourg Mullerthal Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 38 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Luxembourg Mullerthal Route
scenicChapters.narrative: For 43 km this is Luxembourg Mullerthal Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

places-la-place-forte-de-longwy-moselle-.story: From Longwy it runs 353 km to Longwy; allow about 6 h 05 of riding. It goes by way of City of Luxembourg: its Old Quarters and F, Igel Column, Moselle Bridge and back through City of Luxembourg: its Old Quarters and F. It crosses France, Luxembourg and Germany - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
